scope: Focused visual review of the K115 quick-response concealed sprinkler temperature photograph section after the passing browser checks.

observations: The lower photograph section uses a consistent three-column desktop grid.
The 57°C covered and exposed photographs appear first, followed by the 68°C pair.
The photographs show complete product outlines, cover plates, factory labels and exposed mechanisms.
English captions and enlarge links are readable; watermark text occupies clear background space.
The final 141°C covered and exposed photographs appear in the expected order.
The exposed blue-bulb sample is fully visible within the mobile card.
Arabic captions and the enlarge link wrap within the card without clipping or horizontal overflow.
The photograph section ends before the quotation section.
